note.es: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Racion de arranque para terneros en pellet (13-20 % de proteina), saco de 25 kg; el precio por saco se pasa a tonelada (x40). note.en: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Pelleted calf starter ration (13-20 % protein), 25 kg bag; the price per bag is converted to a tonne (x40). Monthly series in Canadian dollars. Unit conversion done by Dehesa Index with exact arithmetic; nothing is estimated.
